basic_profile.bio: I'm an avid traveler and spiritual enthusiast hailing from Austin, Texas. My journey into spirituality began during a backpacking trip across Southeast Asia, where I embraced meditation and mindfulness practices. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me to explore my love for art and creativity. When I'm not working or meditating, you can find me tinkering with electronics and 3D printing projects. I'm currently single, enjoying my independence, and usually online late at night, connecting with like-minded souls around the globe.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in graphic design and digital art, honed through a degree in Fine Arts and years of freelance work. My spiritual journey is self-taught, inspired by travel experiences and reading various philosophies and practices. I'm also fascinated by technology, particularly 3D printing, which I learned through online courses and trial-and-error with my Elegoo Mars printer.
